      public ProxySpecification(Domain domain, Id id)
      Creates a new ProxySpecification.
      Parameters:
      domain - a Domain; must not be null
      id - an Id; must not be null
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if any argument is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if types does not represent a type that can be proxied
